actions.analyze_emotions_from_url.descri: Start a batch emotion analysis job for media files hosted at URLs
Optional webhook URL to receive results when the job completes
Specify which models to use for inference. Leave empty to run all models.
Send email notification upon job completion or failure
Include speech-to-text transcription in the analysis
URLs to media files to analyze (images, videos, audio). Supports up to 100 URLs or archives (.zip, .tar.gz)
actions.create_voice.description: Save a custom voice to your account using a TTS generation ID
The unique ID from a previous TTS generation to save as a custom voice
actions.create_voice.props.voiceName.des: A descriptive name for your custom voice
actions.delete_voice.description: Delete a custom voice from your account
actions.delete_voice.props.voiceName.des: The name of the custom voice to delete
actions.generate_speech_from_file.descri: Convert audio file to speech using Hume AI's expressive text-to-speech technology
Description for the context text (how it should sound)
Optional context text to influence speech style and prosody consistency
Speed multiplier for the synthesized speech (0.75-1.5 recommended)
Automatically split text into natural-sounding speech segments
The text to convert to speech
Duration of silence to add at the end of the speech
Natural language description of how the speech should sound (tone, accent, style, etc.). If no voice is specified, this will generate a dynamic voice.
actions.generate_text_to_speech.descript: Convert text to speech using Hume AI's expressive text-to-speech technology
actions.generate_text_to_speech.props.co: Description for the context text (how it should sound)
Optional context text to influence speech style and prosody consistency
actions.generate_text_to_speech.props.nu: Number of audio generations to produce (1-5 recommended)
actions.generate_text_to_speech.props.sp: Speed multiplier for the synthesized speech (0.75-1.5 recommended)
Automatically split text into natural-sounding speech segments
actions.generate_text_to_speech.props.te: The text to convert to speech
actions.generate_text_to_speech.props.tr: Duration of silence to add at the end of the speech
actions.generate_text_to_speech.props.vo: Natural language description of how the speech should sound (tone, accent, style, etc.). If no voice is specified, this will generate a dynamic voice.
